free_tier.stated: DNS zones and records are managed in Hetzner Console and the API for free; up to 25 zones by default, up to 500 records per zone and 50 records per RRset; a domain you own is required

per_object_cap.stated: up to 500 records per zone and 50 records per RRset, the 500 raisable on a justified demand; up to 25 zones by default

retention.stated: a zone that is not delegated to the Hetzner name servers for more than 28 days is deleted automatically; nothing else is stated about inactivity

egress.terms: no DNS query cap published on the pages read

interface_detail: the Hetzner Cloud API at https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1/ with an Authorization Bearer project token: POST /zones creates a zone, and POST /zones/{id_or_name}/rrsets/{rr_name}/{rr_type}/actions/set_records replaces the records of a record set; there is no dyndns2 or HTTP-GET update URL, so a dynamic update is an API call with a token; the default rate limit is 3600 requests per hour per project; zone names must be a registrable domain under a public suffix, not a subdomain
tooling: curl, the hcloud CLI (hcloud zone create), BIND zone-file import, and AXFR secondary zones against an external primary
chaining: a zone can also run as a secondary that copies a primary elsewhere by AXFR, and a zone can be shared across projects for managed certificates and load balancers; it cannot hold a name that is not a domain you own

limits.value: up to 500 records per zone, 50 records per RRset, 25 zones by default
3600 API requests per hour per project, refilling 1 request per second
a zone not delegated to Hetzner name servers for more than 28 days is deleted

binding_note: the owned-domain requirement and the 25-zone default decide; the record cap is not binding for a personal set of names

identity_cost.detail: an account needs a valid e-mail address, personal or business contact information and a billing address, with a phone number optional; Hetzner may ask an account to verify before it processes an order, by a government ID copy or by a credit-card prepayment; unverified: whether creating a DNS zone triggers that verification (https://docs.hetzner.com/general/billing-and-account-management/account-getting-started/, https://docs.hetzner.com/general/security-and-identify/fraud-prevention-faq/)

reliability_note: an undelegated zone is deleted after 28 days, and a new account can be asked for an ID copy or a card prepayment before it can order
confidence_note: the DNS Console page, the DNS overview and limits page, the creating-a-zone page, the DNS FAQ, the Cloud API reference and the account pages were read and quoted; the API was probed once without a token and answered 401. The 25-zone default is on the marketing page and the 500-record limit on the docs page
